correctness.rationale: For all integers c,r>=1 and w in (0,1), direct fiber probabilities give G(z)=B(wz)/B(w), a1=c^r w, a2=binom(c+1,2)^r w^2. If a2-a1^2/2<0, the z^2 coefficient of the m-th convolution root G^(1/m) becomes negative for large m. The strict bounds ((c+1)/(2c))^r <=4/9 when c>=3,r>=2 and <=27/64 when c>=2,r>=3 cover all negative cases. Positive cases are geometric, negative-binomial, or c=r=2 with PGF ((1-w)^3/(1+w))(1+wz)/(1-wz)^3 and strictly positive rates (3+(-1)^(k-1))w^k/k. Exact checker run from packaged path verifies identities and grid; infinite proof does not depend on finite checks.
